# Cerebellum Command Center — UI Design Spec

*Generated by NIM (Nemotron 49B) via PMS — zero Claude tokens spent*

---

## 1. Color System

**Dark Theme Foundation**
- Base: `#121212` (Primary Background)
- Secondary: `#1A1A1A` (Panel Backgrounds)
- Tertiary: `#2D2D2D` (Modals/Overlays)
- Surface: `#333333` (Dropdowns/Tooltips)

**Accent & Semantics**
- Primary Accent: `#4F46E5` (Indigo) — Actions, Headers, Interactive Elements
- Success: `#34A85A` (Green) — Positive Status
- Warning: `#FBD84A` (Yellow) — Warnings, Paused Jobs
- Error: `#EF4444` (Red) — Failures, Errors
- Info: `#60A5FA` (Blue) — Neutral Data (GPU Usage)
- Neutral Text: `#ABB2C2` (Light Gray)
- Disabled: `#5F5F5F` (Dark Gray)

**Depth**
- Shadow Light: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)` — Panel Elevations
- Shadow Dark: `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)` — Modals/Overlays

---

## 2. Typography

**Fonts**
- Body: `Inter` (Variable) — clean modern sans-serif
- Code: `Fira Code` — logs, model names, code snippets

**Scale**
- h1: `24px` / `700` — Module Headers
- h2: `20px` / `600` — Panel Titles
- h3: `16px` / `600` — Subsections
- Body md: `14px` / `400` — Default Text
- Body sm: `12px` / `400` — Metadata, Timestamps
- Code: `12px` / `400` — Inline Code

---

## 3. Layout Architecture

**Global Structure**
- Sidebar Nav: Fixed, `72px` width, collapsed on mobile (<768px)
  - Logo (Top)
  - Module Icons (Dashboard, Model Discovery, etc.)
  - Bottom: User Settings, Theme Toggle
- Main Content:
  - Header: `64px` height — Breadcrumbs + Page Title + Actions
  - Panel Grid: Responsive 12-column grid with `gap-6`

**Responsive Breakpoints**
- Mobile `<768px`: Collapsed sidebar, stacked panels, simplified charts
- Tablet `768-1024px`: Sidebar expanded, 2-column grid
- Desktop `≥1024px`: Full sidebar, 3-4 column grid

---

## 4. Component Hierarchy by Module

### Dashboard (Home)
- `JobStatusCard` — Live/Queued/Failed with `SparkChart` runtime trend
- `GaugeChart` — Circular GPU/Disk gauges with tooltip
- `NewsCard` — HF Blog RSS with `ReadMoreButton`
- `ActionGrid` — Icons + Labels for quick-launch

### Model Discovery
- `SearchInput` + `FilterChipGroup` (Arch/Size/License)
- `ModelCard` — Image, Name, Stats, Download Button
- `DownloadProgressBar` on hover

### Autopilot Control
- `RunButtonGroup` — Start/Pause/Cancel
- `LogTerminal` — Monospaced, auto-scrolling WebSocket stream
- `HeatmapGrid` — Layers × Tensor Groups, color-scaled PPL delta with hover tooltip
- `MiniGauge` — Inline GPU/Disk next to run controls

### Benchmark Suite
- `TabGroup` — PPL, HumanEval, ARC, etc.
- `RunButton` + `VersionSelector`
- `DataTable` — Side-by-side comparison
- `LineChart` (Recharts) with Compare Version toggle

### Sensitivity Atlas
- `ModelOverlay` — Multi-select, searchable model picker
- `CrossModelHeatmap` — Drag-to-zoom, layer/tensor labels
- `TensorInspector` — Metadata panel, overlay toggle

### Task-Specific Quant Builder
- `TensorList` — Draggable items
- `DropZone` — Q2_K/Q3_K/Q4_K/Q5_K zones with visual feedback
- `BudgetCard` — Real-time file size / accuracy impact

### Model Card Generator
- `ModelCardPreview` — Markdown render
- `FormInputs` — Title, Description, Tags
- `HFUploadButton` — With loading state

### Data Explorer & Chat
- `MessageList` — User/LLM responses
- `QueryInput` — Autocomplete for metrics
- `DynamicChart` — Rendered on query

---

## 5. Key Interaction Patterns

**Real-Time Updates**
- WebSocket: `ws://api/autopilot/{run_id}` for logs + heatmap deltas
- GPU Stats: `setInterval` fallback if WebSocket drops

**Comparisons**
- Version Toggle: Select two versions → DataTable merges
- Atlas: Overlay models with opacity controls

**Heatmap**
- Zoom: `Ctrl+Scroll` or pinch
- Filter: Click layer/tensor to isolate in Inspector

**Drag & Drop**
- `react-beautiful-dnd` for tensor reordering in Quant Builder
- Visual ghost element during drag

**Navigation**
- `react-router` with preloaded data (no spinners)
- Skeleton screens for slow APIs (HF Model Search)

---

## 6. shadcn/ui Components

**Core**: Button, ButtonGroup, Input, Select, Slider, DataTable, Modal, Tooltip, Card
**Autopilot**: LogViewer (custom terminal), Gauge (mini GPU/Disk)
**Benchmark**: ComparisonTable (side-by-side)
**Atlas**: Heatmap (custom SVG grid)
**Builder**: DraggableList, BudgetDisplay

---

## 7. Design Philosophy

- **Data Density**: Grid layouts, compact padding (`py-2`, `px-3`)
- **Performance**: Lazy-load non-critical components
- **Consistency**: Reuse Card components with shadcn/ui styling
- **Accessibility**: Semantic colors, aria-labels, keyboard nav
- **Vibe**: Grafana × Vercel × Linear — professional, dark, data-rich, fast
